title: brahmacariyaṃ sāraṃ
titleEn: The Heartwood of the Spiritual Life
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“… So, this spiritual life, bhikkhus, does not have gain, honor, and renown for its benefit,
nor the attainment of virtue for its benefit,
nor the attainment of concentration for its benefit,
nor knowledge and vision for its benefit.
But it is this unshakeable deliverance of mind that is the goal of this spiritual life, its heartwood, and its end.”
